exposure: Lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma of the cervix (LELC) diagnosis
surgical treatment (radical hysterectomy with pelvic lymph-adenectomy)
cohort: A single 40-year-old female patient diagnosed with IB1 stage Lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma of the cervix (LELC).
finding: A 40-year-old female patient with LELC (IB1 stage) successfully underwent surgery and radiotherapy, showing no recurrence and good general condition 36 months post-treatment.
